g2411.why: The Berean prints both as "temple"; Abbott-Smith distinguishes them.
g2411.source: Abbott-Smith (1922), via STEP Bible: ἱερόν is "the entire precincts or some part thereof (as distinct from ὁ ναός … the Sanctuary proper)"; ναός is "the temple building proper, or sanctuary, … as distinct from τ. ἱερόν (…), the whole temple enclosure".
